say:1:1041551101:1.text: Hmm-hmm-hmm—hmm-hmm—this melody's kinda fun, don't you think?
say:1:1041551101:1.source_cn: 嗯哼哼——哼哼——这个调子不错吧？

say:2:1041551102:1.text: Oh, it's great! Such a bubbly tune! But... hmm, it's still missing a little something.
say:2:1041551102:1.source_cn: 很不错！非常欢快的旋律！但总感觉不够热血沸腾啊。

say:3:1041551103:1.text: With the Emberlight battles being so wild, we need something with a bit more pizzazz for the entrance music!
say:3:1041551103:1.source_cn: 毕竟春焰比武的时候那么吵闹，登场音乐必须要更有存在感才行。

say:4:1041551104:1.text: Good point... Okay, how about this? Let's add some drums and your bells to the mix!
say:4:1041551104:1.source_cn: 有道理……那不如这样，这个地方加入鼓和你的铃铛！

say:5:1041551105:1.text: Da-da-da! Boom! Da! Now it feels way better!
say:5:1041551105:1.source_cn: 哒啦啦！砰！哒！这样就很有感觉了！

say:6:1041551106:1.text: Yes! Now we're talking! Let's speed it up even more—I'm already getting hyped!
say:6:1041551106:1.source_cn: 太棒了！这里还能加快点速度——我已经充满激情了！

say:7:1041551107:1.text: Me too! Just hearing this makes me wanna start dancing right here!
say:7:1041551107:1.source_cn: 我也是，光是想象一下这个调子，就忍不住要跳起舞来！

say:8:1041551108:1.text: Ooh, and after the battle, let's dance together! Under all those fireworks!
say:8:1041551108:1.source_cn: 那么，在比武结束后，我们一起去跳舞吧！在烟花下面！

say:9:1041551109:1.text: That sounds amazing! The fireworks' boom will be the perfect beat—boom—da-da-da!
say:9:1041551109:1.source_cn: 太妙了！这样的话，烟花的声音也能成为节拍！砰——哒哒哒！
